summary_en: Convano will acquire 37.29 million shares from Dimensional Inc. at 100 yen per share for a total of 3.73 billion yen through off-market transaction, with settlement on October 23, 2026. The acquired shares will be cancelled except those needed for fractional share buyback requests.
title_en: Notice Regarding Progress of Share Acquisition from Specific Shareholder
translation_en_brief:
On October 16, 2026, Convano's board of directors determined the specific terms for acquiring 37,289,600 shares from Dimensional Inc. under Company Law Article 157, following shareholder approval at an extraordinary general meeting on September 30, 2026. The acquisition price is set at 100 yen per share, for a total payment of 3,728,960,000 yen. The transaction will be conducted as an off-market relative transaction with a settlement date of October 23, 2026. This acquisition falls within the parameters previously disclosed on August 24, 2026, and approved by the extraordinary general meeting regarding acquisition volume, total consideration, and acquisition period.

The funding for this acquisition will be sourced from the company's sale of cryptocurrency holdings, with no drawdown from operating cash reserves. The company has confirmed that distributable funds will exceed the total acquisition price at the effective date of the transaction, in compliance with Company Law Article 461(2).

Following completion of the acquisition, Convano will cancel all acquired shares as promptly as possible, except for shares needed to fulfill buyback requests from fractional shareholders under the fractional share redemption system. The company will announce timing and details of the cancellation once finalized. The acquisition is not expected to impact the company's financial results for the fiscal year ending March 31, 2027.
